15308.name: A Small Intersection

east.description: To the east lies In An Old Archway.

west.description: To the west lies An Odd Room.

15308.description:
Two worn passages cross here beneath a low vaulted ceiling, and the damp
has bloomed black along every seam of the stone. A single drip falls
somewhere close, with the patience of a clock. The way east narrows to
an old archway, while the passage west bends off toward an odd room
whose far end you cannot make out. Cold air seeps across the flagstones
and stirs the dust into slow rings.

15309.name: A Slippery Room

south.description: To the south lies In Front Of A Pink Tomb.

15309.description:
The flagstones are coated with a glassy slime, and a tiny stream runs
across the floor from one wall to the other and disappears. You test
each step before trusting it. The only dry spot is the doorway south,
which leads to a pink tomb.

15310.name: An Odd Room

south.description: To the south lies A Sleepy Room.

west.description: To the west lies A Slippery Room.

15310.description:
Nothing in this room is quite square: the floor slopes, the walls lean,
and the roof has a hump like a sleeping animal's back. A cracked mirror
frame hangs on the wall, empty of glass. A doorway leads south to a
sleepy room, and a slick passage west goes on to a slippery room.

15311.name: The Secret Room

north.description: To the north lies A Small Passage.

south.description: To the south lies An Odd Passageway.

up.description: To the up lies The Holy Altar.

15311.description:
A round chamber hidden behind the catacomb walls, its floor inlaid with
a ring of faded runes that still seem faintly warm. Dust lies thick upon
a stone dais except where it has been disturbed in a long, dragging
track. A narrow stair climbs up toward the Holy Altar in Welmar's
Castle, while dark passages lead north and south. The air hums low and
patient, like a breath held under the stone.

extra_descs.runes ring floor:
The runes are cut deep and filled with some dark paste that has never
quite dried. They form a ring around the dais, and the dust has been
wiped from one arc of it.

15312.name: In An Old Archway

east.description: To the east lies A Small Study Room.

south.description: To the south lies A Smelly Room.

15312.description:
You stand beneath an ancient archway of fitted stones, its keystone
cracked and furred with pale mould. Water beads on the curve above and
falls in slow drops upon your shoulders. A door to the east opens on a
small study, and the passage south breathes out a sour, rotten odour.
Scratches in the mortar might be old tally marks, or the work of claws.

15313.name: A Small Study Room

south.description: To the south lies In Front Of A Golden Tomb.

15313.description:
A cramped study has been cut into the rock, with a stooped writing desk,
a three-legged stool and shelves whose books have swollen into grey
pulp. A bracket on the wall holds only a crust of old candle wax, and a
cabinet door hangs open on empty pigeonholes. Mildew climbs the plaster
in slow green tongues. A narrow doorway in the far wall leads south
toward a faint gleam of gold.

15314.name: In Front Of A Pink Tomb

east.description: To the east lies A Sleepy Room.

15314.description:
The tomb here is of rose-pink marble, cracked along one side and carved
with a wreath of stone flowers whose petals have crumbled to nubs. It is
the gentlest tomb in the catacombs, and somehow the saddest. Dry leaves
of long-dead blooms lie against the base. The way back leads east to a
sleepy room.

extra_descs.pink tomb wreath flowers:
The wreath of stone flowers runs all around the lid, each blossom a
little different, as if carved from memory. A name was cut at the foot,
but the damp has taken all but the first letter.

15315.name: A Sleepy Room

east.description: To the east lies A Small Passage.

south.description: To the south lies A Dusty Room.

15315.description:
A low plastered ceiling here is painted with faded stars, most of them
flaked away to bare lime. Wooden pegs along the wall hold nothing but
cobweb, and a long stone bench runs under them. A small passage leads
east, while south the way goes on to a dusty room.

15316.name: A Small Passage

north.description: To the north lies A Small Intersection.

15316.description:
A cramped passage hardly wider than a man's shoulders, with a roof so
low its stones brush your hair. Water trickles along a groove cut in the
floor and vanishes into a crack. Scratches mark the walls at the height
of a hand, many and close together, as if someone had once tried to
climb out. The passage runs on north to a small intersection.

15317.name: A Smelly Room

south.description: To the south lies A Strange Passageway.

west.description: To the west lies A Small Passage.

15317.description:
A fetid reek hangs in this low room, thick with rot and old wet earth,
and green slime has crept down one wall in long runnels. The floor dips
in the middle to a shallow puddle that never dries. A passage opens
south into a strangely shaped way, and another runs west toward a small
passage. Somewhere beyond the walls something drips and drips.

15318.name: In Front Of A Golden Tomb

west.description: To the west lies A Smelly Room.

15318.description:
The passage ends before a great tomb of golden marble veined with amber,
its lid carved with a crowned figure whose face has been worn almost
smooth. Flecks of gilt glitter in the damp, and the air is heavy and
still, as though the chamber were holding its breath. A cracked bronze
lamp-stand leans against the foot of the tomb. The only way out is back
west toward a smelly room.

extra_descs.golden tomb marble lid figure:
The lid is carved with a crowned figure, hands folded on a sword, the
gold veins of the marble running through him like old fire. The
inscription at his feet has been scraped away.

15319.name: A Strange Passageway

west.description: To the west lies The Secret Room.

15319.description:
The passage twists unnaturally here, its walls leaning in at odd angles
until the ceiling seems to tilt above your head. Faint chalk marks, half
washed away, spiral along the stones in a pattern that hurts the eye to
follow. The air tastes of cold iron. To the west a heavy door of dark
wood stands ajar, and past it lies the secret room.

15320.name: A Dusty Room

east.description: To the east lies The Secret Room.

15320.description:
Dust lies in grey drifts here, heavy as felt, and cobwebs hang in sheets
from the roof beams. Nothing moves except the motes turning in a faint
draught. Your footprints are the first in a very long time, or so it
seems. The only way on leads east to the secret room.

15321.name: A Noisy Room

south.description: To the south lies In Front Of A Shadowy Tomb.

15321.description:
Every surface in this room seems to make a sound: loose stones clink
underfoot, a pipe somewhere knocks, and water gurgles in a crack. The
walls pass the noise around in the hollow dark, so you cannot tell where
any of it begins. The passage leads south toward a shadowy tomb.

15322.name: A Large Intersection

north.description: To the north lies A Dusty Room.

east.description: To the east lies An Odd Passageway.

west.description: To the west lies A Noisy Room.

15322.description:
This is the widest crossing in the catacombs, a high hall where four
pillars hold up a vault gone black with age. Passages leave it north to
a dusty room, east toward an odd passageway and west toward a noisy
room. A great circle of mosaic is set in the floor, most of its tiles
long gone, and a low murmur drifts in from the dark.

15323.name: An Odd Passageway

south.description: To the south lies A Small Intersection.

15323.description:
The floor of this passage tilts gently, so that a dropped coin would
roll away toward the next chamber, and the walls are pocked with niches
too small for any coffin. Pale roots have forced through the mortar
overhead and dangle like fingers. Your footsteps come back a half-second
late, as though something walked behind you. The passage runs south to a
small intersection.

15324.name: A Smelly Room

north.description: To the north lies A Strange Passageway.

west.description: To the west lies An Odd Passageway.

15324.description:
The stench is worse here, a sweet, heavy rot that clings to the back of
the throat. Black water has pooled in a cracked basin in the floor,
ringed with a scum of green. Long smears on the walls show where
something large has dragged itself along. A passage north leads to the
strange passageway, and another goes west toward an odd one.

15325.name: In Front Of A White Marble Tomb

west.description: To the west lies A Smelly Room.

15325.description:
A tomb of white marble stands here, spotless where everything else is
stained, its sides carved with weeping figures whose faces are veiled.
Cold radiates from the stone, and your breath clouds before it. Two dead
iron sconces flank the tomb, their cups full of black water. The only
way back leads west to the smelly room.

15326.name: A Small Windy Room

north.description: To the north lies In Front Of A White Marble Tomb.

15326.description:
In this small room the draught squeezes through a crack and whistles
thinly in the roof, like a child humming to itself. The walls sweat, and
the flagstones have been polished by the damp to a dark shine. A low
arch in the wall to the north opens on a pale gleam of white marble.

15327.name: A Windy Room

north.description: To the north lies A Smelly Room.

east.description: To the east lies A Small Windy Room.

15327.description:
A gale that has no business underground howls through this room, tugging
at your cloak and setting a rusted chain swinging from the ceiling. Dust
devils spin across the flags and settle in the corners. The wind carries
a sour smell down from the smelly room to the north, and the way east
leads on to a smaller, quieter windy chamber.

15328.name: A Small Intersection

east.description: To the east lies A Windy Room.

south.description: To the south lies A Cross Point Between The Rooms.

west.description: To the west lies A Sleepy Room.

15328.description:
Three ways part here beneath a groined ceiling, the stone sooty from
torches long gone. A cold draught pours in from the east, where a windy
room moans, while south lies a cross point between the rooms and west a
sleepy room, hushed as a bedchamber. Grit crunches underfoot, and a thin
skin of damp has settled on every ledge.

15329.name: A Sleepy Room

north.description: To the north lies A Large Intersection.

15329.description:
A hush lies over this room, deep as wool. Low stone shelves like bunks
line the walls, each cut to the length of a sleeping body and strewn
with rotted bedding. No draught stirs the cobwebs strung between them.
The passage north leads to a large intersection.

15330.name: In Front Of A Shadowy Tomb

east.description: To the east lies A Sleepy Room.

15330.description:
A tomb of dark stone crouches in a recess where no light seems to reach,
its edges blurred by shadow. Soot-black niches pit the walls, and the
cold here is thick and clinging. Your own shadow looks longer than it
should. A passage east returns to a sleepy room.

15331.name: A Cross Point Between The Rooms

south.description: To the south lies A Slippery Intersection.

west.description: To the west lies A Sleepy Room.

15331.description:
Passages meet here at a crossing worn smooth by generations of feet,
with blind doorways on every side that lead nowhere you can reach. An
empty lantern hook, red with rust, juts from a pillar. The floor is
slick with seep, and the sound of dripping comes from every direction at
once. A way leads south toward a slippery intersection, and another west
to a sleepy room.

15332.name: A Slippery Intersection

east.description: To the east lies A Well Furnished Room.

west.description: To the west lies A Dirty Room.

15332.description:
Glossy green slime coats the floor of this junction, and every step is a
small gamble. Runnels of water thread between the flagstones toward a
drain choked with grit. To the east a doorway opens on a room with the
faded remains of comfort, while west the passage gives onto a dirty
room.

15333.name: A Well Furnished Room

north.description: To the north lies A Cross Point Between The Rooms.

east.description: To the east lies A Boring Room.

15333.description:
Whoever kept this chamber meant to stay: a carved bedstead rots in one
corner, a table with turned legs stands under a mouldered cloth, and a
tapestry hangs in rags above a cold hearth. Nothing here has seen use
for a century, and the damp has swollen every joint. The way north
returns to the cross point, and east leads on to a boring room.

15334.name: A Boring Room

south.description: To the south lies In Front Of A Brass Tomb.

15334.description:
Bare walls, bare floor, bare ceiling: the builders gave this room
nothing to look at. A single pale stain on the stones is all that breaks
the grey, and even that has the shape of nothing in particular. The only
door leads south, where a dull glint of brass shows in the dark.

15335.name: In Front Of A Brass Tomb

west.description: To the west lies A Hot Room.

15335.description:
The tomb here is cast in brass, green with age at its seams and rubbed
bright in places where hands have touched it for luck or for worse
reasons. A heat shimmer lifts from the metal, strange in so damp a
place. Old wax and ash are caked on the lid in rings. The way out lies
west into a hot room.

15336.name: A Hot Room

north.description: To the north lies A Well Furnished Room.

west.description: To the west lies A Very Hot Intersection.

15336.description:
Heat presses on you as though a forge burned behind the wall, and the
stones are warm and dry to the touch while the rest of the catacombs
weep. The air shimmers and tastes of scorched dust. Soot streaks the
ceiling above the cracks in the floor. A passage north goes back to the
well furnished room, and west the way runs on to a very hot
intersection.

15337.name: A Very Hot Intersection

north.description: To the north lies A Slippery Intersection.

south.description: To the south lies Inside A Large Tunnel.

15337.description:
The heat peaks at this crossing, and sweat runs into your eyes before
you have gone three paces. The walls are cracked and baked, the mortar
gone to a powder that sifts down at every footfall. To the north the way
leads back toward the slippery intersection, and south it opens into the
mouth of a large tunnel breathing cooler air.

15338.name: Inside A Bloody Room

north.description: To the north lies A Dirty Room.

east.description: To the east lies A Very Hot Intersection.

15338.description:
Rust-red stains cover wall and floor in broad splashes, dried to a brown
crust that flakes beneath your boots. A butcher's hook hangs from a
ceiling beam, still swaying a little as if lately touched. The passage
north leads to a dirty room, and to the east the heat of a very hot
intersection spills in.

15339.name: In Front Of A Red Tomb

east.description: To the east lies Inside A Bloody Room.

15339.description:
The tomb in this chamber is of red marble, streaked and veined like raw
meat, and it seems to glisten even where the stone is dry. Dark stains
have run from its lid down the sides and gathered in the cracks of the
floor. The walls close in on every side but one. The way out lies east,
toward a bloody room.

15340.name: A Cold Room

south.description: To the south lies In Front Of A Red Tomb.

15340.description:
A deathly chill gathers in this room, and your breath hangs in white
curls before your face. The stone is cold to the point of pain, and the
damp on the walls has hardened into little glass beads. A thin whisper
passes along the ceiling and dies. The only way on leads south to a red
tomb.

15341.name: A Dirty Room

west.description: To the west lies A Cold Room.

15341.description:
Filth lies in drifts across the floor of this room, a grey sludge of
dust, mould and old straw trodden into paste. Handprints smear the walls
at shoulder height, as though someone had felt their way along in the
dark. The air is thick and close. A doorway leads west to a cold room.

15342.name: Inside A Large Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies A Very Hot Intersection.

west.description: To the west lies Along A Long Tunnel.

15342.description:
A broad tunnel hewn from raw rock, wide enough for a cart, runs through
the dark here. Its roof is lost overhead and its sides glisten with a
skin of water. Ruts long since dried into the floor show where heavy
loads once rolled. The way north returns to the very hot intersection,
while the tunnel runs west along a long stretch.

15343.name: Along A Long Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Inside A Large Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies The End Of A Long Tunnel.

15343.description:
The tunnel stretches on, narrow and ruler-straight, and every sound you
make races ahead into the dark and comes back thinned. Drips fall from
the roof in a slow count. Pale fungus dots the walls in patches the size
of a hand. East lies the broader part of the tunnel, and west the way
runs on to its end.

15344.name: The End Of A Long Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Along A Long Tunnel.

down.description: To the down lies Some Slippery Stairs.

15344.description:
The tunnel ends in a rough shelf of rock where a stair drops away into
blackness. Chisel marks cover the end wall, and a groove has been worn
in the stone lip by years of ropes dragged over it. Cold, wet air rises
from the stairs leading down. Back east, the tunnel runs along its
length.

15345.name: Some Slippery Stairs

up.description: To the up lies The End Of A Long Tunnel.

down.description: To the down lies Some Slippery Stairs.

15345.description:
Narrow steps wind steeply downward, each one hollowed in the middle and
slick with a film of green. You keep a hand on the wall, and the wall is
no help, as wet and cold as a fish. The stair climbs up toward the end
of a long tunnel and descends again into the dark.

15346.name: Some Slippery Stairs

up.description: To the up lies Some Slippery Stairs.

down.description: To the down lies Some Slippery Stairs.

15346.description:
The steps are broken and uneven here, one in four missing a corner, and
water runs down the stair in a thin, unbroken sheet. The sound of it
fills the shaft, a chuckle that never stops. Above, the stairs lead up
toward the tunnel, and below they sink deeper into the rock.

15347.name: Some Slippery Stairs

east.description: To the east lies A Wet Tunnel.

up.description: To the up lies Some Slippery Stairs.

15347.description:
The stairs end in a small landing awash with an inch of cold water, and
the last step is lost beneath it. A low tunnel opens east, its walls
shining with damp. The stair behind you climbs up into the dark, and the
echoes of your splashing run along the rock.

15348.name: A Wet Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Along A Wet Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies Some Slippery Stairs.

15348.description:
Water seeps from the walls into a channel along the floor, and the whole
tunnel is cold, close and dripping. Moss grows in dark cushions above
the waterline, and the roof stoops low enough to make you duck. The
stairs lie to the west, and the tunnel goes on east along its wet
length.

15349.name: Along A Wet Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies A Turning Point Along The Wet Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Wet Tunnel.

15349.description:
The tunnel bends south here, the rock slick and the floor ankle-deep in
a flow that drains toward the dark. A rusted iron ring is set into the
wall, from which a chain once hung. Beads of water race one another down
the stone. West the passage runs back along the wet tunnel.

15350.name: A Turning Point Along The Wet Tunnel

north.description: To the north lies Along A Wet Tunnel.

east.description: To the east lies In The Depths Of A Wet Tunnel.

15350.description:
The tunnel turns a sharp corner here, and the stone is gnawed smooth
where water has beaten against it for centuries. A mutter of falling
water comes from further on. A slump of loose rock half fills one side
of the passage. The way north leads back along the wet tunnel, and east
it goes deeper.

15351.name: In The Depths Of A Wet Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies Lost In A Wet Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies A Turning Point Along The Wet Tunnel.

15351.description:
Here the tunnel dives into true darkness, the walls glistening and
close, and the water underfoot runs cold enough to ache. A pale crust of
mineral has grown over old tool marks in the rock. Somewhere ahead a
heavy murmur of water is felt more than heard. West the passage leads
back toward a turning point, and east it goes on into a stretch where it
is easy to lose your way.

15352.name: Lost In A Wet Tunnel

east.description: To the east lies In The Depths Of A Wet Tunnel.

west.description: To the west lies In The Depths Of A Wet Tunnel.

15352.description:
Cracks and false turnings fork off through the rock, each as dark as the
last, and every drip sounds like a footstep. Small heaps of stone stand
here and there like cairns, left by people who feared to lose their way.
The tunnel runs on east and west, and neither end looks different from
the other.

15353.name: In The Depths Of A Wet Tunnel

south.description: To the south lies In Front Of The Underground River.

west.description: To the west lies Lost In A Wet Tunnel.

15353.description:
The roar of moving water is loud now, and a cold mist drifts through the
tunnel and beads on your skin. The floor slopes toward the sound, and
the rock is as slick as soap. Stalactites drip in long, glassy threads
from the roof. West the tunnel runs back toward the lost stretch, and
south it opens on the river.

15354.name: In Front Of The Underground River

north.description: To the north lies In The Depths Of A Wet Tunnel.

south.description: To the south lies Riding The Rapids.

15354.description:
The tunnel opens onto a ledge above a black river that races past in a
rush of spray, loud in the enclosed dark. Wet rock glitters on every
side, and an iron ring is fixed into the stone for the mooring of boats.
The only way on is south, onto the water itself, where rapids boil under
the low roof. North the tunnel runs back into the depths.

642400.name: grave rat
642400.long_desc: A fat grave rat creeps along the base of the wall, whiskers twitching.
642400.description:
Bloated on what the catacombs leave lying about, this rat is the size of
a cat, with matted fur and yellow teeth. Its eyes shine red in the dark.

642401.name: tomb skeleton bones
642401.long_desc: A tomb skeleton shuffles through the dark, a rusted blade in its bony hand.
642401.description:
Grave-dirt clings to the yellowed bones, and tatters of shroud hang from
its ribs. Two cold sparks burn deep in its empty eye sockets.

642402.name: mouldering zombie corpse
642402.long_desc: A mouldering zombie lurches across the floor, trailing wet rags and a sour stench.
642402.description:
The corpse has been in the damp too long, and what is left of its flesh
sags from the bone in grey folds. It moves with the patient, stubborn
gait of the long dead.

642403.name: crypt ghoul
642403.long_desc: A gaunt crypt ghoul crouches in the gloom, gnawing at something it will not show you.
642403.description:
Long-limbed and hairless, the ghoul has skin like wet parchment
stretched over a starved frame. Its claws are black to the knuckle and
its jaw hangs wider than any living mouth should.

642404.name: weeping ghost spirit
642404.long_desc: A weeping ghost drifts above the flagstones, pale hands pressed to its face.
642404.description:
The ghost is the faint shape of a woman in a burial gown, and her tears
fall as silver mist that never reaches the floor. Her wail climbs when
you draw near, and the air turns cold as a grave.

642405.name: harl gravewhisper cultist
642405.long_desc: Harl Gravewhisper, the grave cultist, kneels by the dais and murmurs over the runes.
642405.description:
Harl is a stooped man in a soiled black robe, his hands stained with
grave-dirt to the wrist. A silver chain bearing a bone charm hangs at
his throat, and he mutters without pause to something that has not yet
answered.

642406.name: aldric vane crypt lord skeleton
642406.short_desc: Aldric Vane, the skeletal crypt lord
642406.long_desc: Aldric Vane, the skeletal crypt lord, stands guard over the golden tomb in tarnished armour.
642406.description:
A tall skeleton in a gilded breastplate stands with a black sword
planted point down before him. A circlet of gold still sits on his
skull, and green fire burns where his eyes once were. He does not so
much move as unfold, as if the tomb behind him were his to defend until
the world ends.

742400.name: burial coin tarnished
742400.room_desc: A tarnished burial coin lies here.
742400.description: A thick silver coin, green at the edges, stamped with a sleeping face. It was meant to pay a ferryman who never came.

742401.name: bone handled dagger
742401.description: The handle is yellowed bone worn smooth by many hands, and the narrow blade still keeps a wicked point. Grave-dirt stains the cross-guard.

742402.name: grave warden ring silver
742402.room_desc: A silver ring set with a black stone lies here.
742402.description: A heavy silver ring, the black stone in it cut with a tiny closed eye. It is cold against the skin and seems to listen.

742403.name: black sword vane blade
742403.short_desc: the black sword of Aldric Vane
742403.room_desc: A long black sword lies here, rimed with grave-dust.
742403.description: The blade is dark iron that drinks the light, its edge as keen as the day it was forged. A line of old runes runs down the fuller.

742404.name: gilded death mask gold
742404.room_desc: A gilded death mask lies here, staring at the ceiling.
742404.description: A mask of beaten gold in the likeness of a calm, proud face, worn over the brow with age. Through its empty eyes the world seems a shade colder.
